• Chennaiyin FC vs Punjab FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 31 || 21-Nov-2026 || English ||
An own goal and an equaliser, both from Punjab! Watch the big moments as Chennaiyin FC and Punjab FC drew 1-1 in Chennai in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Nikhil Prabhu's own goal put Chennaiyin ahead early, but Raphael Messi Bouli levelled before half-time. Punjab created more after the break and finished with 15 shots, while Chennaiyin held on for the point.
Match highlight: Chennaiyin are unbeaten in three, and Messi Bouli has scored in three of Punjab's five games.
